decisions.reason: The one-click Winners-page claim flow does not change the VRF provider, winner-selection execution, fairness, verification surface, or applicable draws.
The claim interface changes how an awarded prize is collected, not the Big Block winner count, prize amount, or draw condition.
The prize-claim flow does not alter ticket eligibility, expiration, burning, resetting, or carry-forward behavior.
The Winners-page claim control does not change the Small Block prize amount, winner count, eligibility, pool trigger, or funding behavior.
The candidate already records the complete approved FAQ copy from this message, including reward claims; the claim-flow decision requires no additional FAQ-state change.
The prize-claim surface and control do not alter the mint price, commission, founder share, or prize-pool destinations.
The one-click prize-claim flow does not change which book access, referral identity, badges, or expired-ticket state follows an NFT transfer.
The source distinguishes automatically transferred commissions from one-click prize claims, so the existing commission amount, trigger, recipient, destination, and timing remain unchanged.
Publishing prize wins on the Winners page does not change the required NFT metadata counters, badges, or referral-code attributes.
The prize-claim interaction does not alter badge thresholds, award basis, or on-chain attachment.
Adding a Winners-page claim flow does not change the selected Base blockchain network.
The prize-claim flow is independent of the deferred Discord launch and its traction-based launch condition.
